title: Mischievous Mermaid | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach along scenic 30A, this impressive three-story coastal estate offers an exceptional setting for large gatherings and memorable beach escapes. Spanning over 6,000 square feet, the home is thoughtfully designed with spacious living areas, refined coastal finishes, and multiple entertainment spaces throughout. The main living level serves as the heart of the home, featuring an inviting great room, an elegant dining area, and a chef-inspired kitchen with premium appliances and an expansive island ideal for gathering. Large balconies and upper-level vantage points showcase beautiful Gulf views, while the rooftop terrace provides a spectacular setting for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying coastal sunsets. Designed with both comfort and recreation in mind, the home features multiple private bedroom suites, welcoming lounge areas, and a dedicated game room equipped with classic pinball machines, shuffleboard, and gaming entertainment. Outside, a private pool and spa create a resort-style retreat complemented by a summer kitchen, outdoor dining, and comfortable lounge seating for poolside relaxation. With easy beach access just steps away and bikes and a golf cart available for exploring the surrounding 30A communities, this remarkable property offers a luxurious and well-appointed setting for an unforgettable stay along Florida’s Emerald Coast.
